tasks.name: Set up development environment and project structure
Build patient registration and login functionality
Create doctor directory and search functionality
Implement doctor schedule and blocked slots
Build doctor dashboard and appointment list
Develop medical records entry and viewing
Build doctor management interface for admins
Design and implement responsive UI components
Write unit tests for core functionality
Perform security testing and vulnerability assessment

milestones: Patient registration and profile management complete
Admin dashboard and management tools complete
All UI screens designed and implemented
All unit and integration tests passing
risks: Concurrent booking conflicts - mitigate with database transactions and locking
Data breach or security vulnerability - mitigate with encryption, regular security audits
Performance degradation under high load - mitigate with load testing and optimization
HIPAA compliance issues - mitigate with legal review and compliance checklist
Integration complexity with notification services - mitigate with abstraction layer
Database migration issues - mitigate with comprehensive backup and rollback plan
User adoption resistance - mitigate with training and intuitive UI design
Scope creep - mitigate with strict change control process
Third-party service dependencies - mitigate with fallback mechanisms
Time zone handling errors - mitigate with standardized UTC storage and conversion
Browser compatibility issues - mitigate with cross-browser testing
Inadequate testing coverage - mitigate with automated testing and code reviews
